description: This is a test class (InvokeCommandRegistryTest.kt) that verifies the behavior of InvokeCommandRegistry's advertised capabilities and commands, as well as command lookup functionality. It tests feature flags, command inclusion/exclusion, and command metadata for various app protocols.

classes.name: InvokeCommandRegistryTest
classes.description: Test class with multiple unit tests for verifying advertised capabilities, commands, and command lookup behaviors based on feature flags.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_respectsFeatureAvailability
methods.description: Tests that only core capabilities are advertised when no optional features are enabled.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includesFeatureCapabilitiesWhenEnabled
methods.description: Verifies that optional capabilities are included when corresponding flags are enabled.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_respectsFeatureAvailability
methods.description: Checks that only core commands are advertised without optional features.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_includesFeatureCommandsWhenEnabled
methods.description: Ensures that optional commands and debug commands are included when feature flags are turned on.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_onlyIncludesSupportedMotionCommands
methods.description: Verifies that only supported motion commands are included based on feature flags.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_splitsSmsSendAndSearchAvailability
methods.description: Tests that SMS commands are split based on send and search capabilities.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includeSmsWhenEitherSmsPathIsAvailable
methods.description: Verifies SMS capability advertising based on read and send flags.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_excludesCallLogWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Checks that call log commands are excluded if call log feature is disabled.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_excludesCallLogWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Verifies that call log capability is excluded when feature is disabled.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includesVoiceWakeWithoutAdvertisingCommands
methods.description: Ensures voice wake capability is advertised without including voice commands.

methods.name: find_returnsForegroundMetadataForCameraCommands
methods.description: Tests that command lookup returns foreground requirement metadata for certain commands.

methods.name: find_returnsNullForUnknownCommand
methods.description: Checks that the command lookup returns null for unknown commands.

methods.name: defaultFlags
methods.description: Helper function to create default NodeRuntimeFlags with optional parameters to enable features.

methods.name: assertContainsAll
methods.description: Asserts that actual list contains all expected values.

methods.name: assertMissingAll
methods.description: Asserts that actual list contains none of the forbidden values.
